td1e1b904: We’re the only USDA-certified organic strawberry farm in the area, and we grow far fewer berries than conventional farms. Organic practices mean we plant only about one-third of our fields at a time, so supply is limited. In the past, over-picking damaged crops and cost the farm revenue. Reservations help us protect the farm while giving visitors the best experience. Thank you for your patience and support.
